body: Feedback from a host project: the workflow reads as optional because it sits below the command reference; partly-done tickets were closed with 'done (part)' notes; ticket titles/bodies lacked guidance. Add a short lifecycle checklist near the top, a rule never to close incomplete work (note what is left or split-of), and one-sentence guidance on titles and bodies. No fixed body template.
title: SKILL.md: mandatory lifecycle at top, partial-work rule, ticket-writing guidance
